    Profile

    Natalie is the commander of the Scarlet Flame Guard's Mobile Support Squad and a childhood friend of Vettel and Gerald. She has been supporting them since before the Guard was created, and has a protective, sisterly nature. A very curious person, her first instinct when she sees something that piques her interest is to dissect it.

    Origin: Envylia
    Gender: Female
    Height: 157cm
    Weight: 47kg
    Birthday: Aug 20
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Swift Sails
    Likes: Laughing with others
    Hobbies: Encountering the unknown
    Illust: だーくろ
    CV: 明坂聡美
